description: Change an enquiry source. Same fields as create_enquiry_source, plus active (false switches it off without losing what it already brought in).

cost_currency.description: Currency of the cost, default CHF

cost_pattern.description: Regex with one group holding the cost amount in the mail

format.description: Mail reader: labelled 'Field: value' lines or the Schadstoffanalyse reader

from_pattern.description: Substring of the sender address that identifies this source

portal.description: Portal key, e.g. ofri, renovero, localch, schadstoffanalyse or other

source_id.description: ID of the source to change

subject_pattern.description: Substring of the subject that identifies this source

name: update_enquiry_source
